name: Daddy Please
source:
On that fateful night, you return from your job exhausted, unaware of the adventure that was about to unfold.

The moment you enter the house, BAM!!!!

You're given the ultimate task... to get MILK!

Will you make it to the store alive, or will you disappoint your wife and face... the Couch?

[From [url=https://snowkid.itch.io/daddy-please]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在那个决定命运的夜晚，你疲惫不堪地下班回来，没有意识到即将展开的冒险。

当你进屋的那一刻，砰！！！！

你的最终任务是……获取牛奶！

你会活着到达商店，还是会让你的妻子失望并面对……沙发？

[来自[url=https://snowkid.itch.io/daddy-please]Itch.io[/url]]
